title: UI: Renaming a source in the list does not return keyboard or mouse focus to the list

labels.name: Good first issue
labels.description: New to contributing to OBS? Start here!

labels.name: Confirmed
labels.description: This bug report has been confirmed by project members

body:
<!-- READ THIS FIRST -->

<!-- used for reporting Bugs that have replication steps. -->

<!-- You can post Feature Requests here: https://ideas.obsproject.com/ -->

<!--- Provide a general summary of the issue in the Title above -->

## Platform
<!-- Please fill out the following information about your bug report. -->
<!-- If you are on Linux and installed using a package, please list the package type. -->
Operating system and version: Windows 10 2004
OBS Studio version: 25.0.8

## Expected Behavior
Keyboard control should not be lost when renaming an item using F2, allowing selection of items via Arrow Keys.
<!--- Tell us what should happen -->

## Current Behavior
Keyboard focus is lost after renaming an item with F2, disallowing selection with arrow keys.
The focus is lost completely, no item is now in focus.
<!--- Tell us what happens instead of the expected behavior. -->
<!--- Please include a log file here if possible. -->

## Steps to Reproduce
<!--- Provide a link to a live example, or an unambiguous set of steps to -->
<!--- reproduce this bug. Include code to reproduce, if relevant. -->
<!--- Screenshots and video are encouraged if applicable. -->
1. Create two sources of any kind.
2. Select either of them with the mouse in the sources list.
3. Verify that keyboard control is on the list by moving with arrow keys.
4. Rename the current item with F2, and either cancel (ESCAPE) or finish (ENTER) editing.
5. Try to continue controlling the sources list via Keyboard.
6. Notice that it stopped working.

## Additional information
Does not affect scenes, only sources.
